mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, name, active, document_type, currency, min_total, min_discount_percent, mode, separation_of_duties, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM approval_policy WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND active = TRUE ORDER BY name, id
SELECT FROM approval_policy WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE approval_policy SET name = #{name}, active = #{active}, document_type = #{documentType}, currency = #{currency}, min_total = #{minTotal}, min_discount_percent = #{minDiscountPercent}, mode = #{mode}, separation_of_duties = #{separationOfDuties} WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM approval_policy WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.workspace_id, s.policy_id, s.step_order, s.name, s.required_count, s.created_at, s.updated_at, a.id AS approver_id, a.workspace_id AS approver_workspace_id, a.step_id AS approver_step_id, a.approver_kind, a.user_id AS approver_user_id FROM approval_policy_step s LEFT JOIN approval_policy_step_approver a ON a.workspace_id = s.workspace_id AND a.step_id = s.id WHERE s.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND s.policy_id IN #{policyId} ORDER BY s.policy_id, s.step_order, s.id, a.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval_policy_step (workspace_id, policy_id, step_order, name, required_count) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{policyId}, #{stepOrder}, #{name}, #{requiredCount})
INSERT INTO approval_policy_step_approver (workspace_id, step_id, approver_kind, user_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{stepId}, #{approverKind}, #{userId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM approval_policy_step WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND policy_id = #{policyId}
